Theorem lazy_soundness : forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) (ρ : env n),
  ρ_ok γ ρ Γ n γ ->
  forall i, γ i = Lazy ->
  (forall V A, VWt γ Γ V A ->
    exists W, EvalVal γ (ρ <- Absent @ i) V W) /\
  (forall M B, CWt γ Γ M B ->
    exists T, EvalComp γ (ρ <- Absent @ i) M T).

Require Export strictness.cbpv.typing strictness.cbpv.semantics.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Logic.Eqdep_dec.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Peano_dec.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Psatz.

Fixpoint LR {n k} (τ : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) mLower (γCtx : attrs n) :=
    (match τ in Ty _ k return Clos k -> Prop with
    | VUnit => fun C => C = Unit
    | VThunk γ B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (HInner : mOuter <= mInner) (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter),
        down_env_until γ mOuter Hn = γScoped /\
        down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
        C = Thunk mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
        (forall (Hnlower : mLower <= n),
          (down_env_until γCtx mLower Hnlower) γS<= (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) ->
        exists T, EvalComp γInner ρ M T /\ LR B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower γCtx)
    | VProd A1 A2 => fun C => exists W1 W2,
      C = Pair W1 W2 /\ LR A1 W1 mLower γCtx /\ LR A2 W2 mLower γCtx
    | VSum A1 A2 => fun C => exists W',
      (C = Inl W' /\ LR A1 W' mLower γCtx) \/ (C = Inr W' /\ LR A2 W' mLower γCtx)
    | CF A => fun C => exists W, C = Return W /\ LR A W mLower γCtx
    | CAbs q A B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HInner : mOuter <= mInner) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter),
      down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
      C = Closure mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
      (forall W, LR A W mLower γCtx ->
        exists T, EvalComp (q .: γInner) ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M T /\ LR B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower γCtx)
    end) C
.

Definition ρ_ok {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n) mLower γCtx :=
  forall (i : fin n), γ i <> Lazy -> LR (Γ i) (ρ i) mLower γCtx.

Definition SemVWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) V (A : ValTy n) :=
  forall ρ γCtx mLower (Hnlower : mLower <= n), ρ_ok γCtx ρ Γ mLower γCtx ->
    γCtx = pad_with Strict (down_env_until γCtx mLower Hnlower) n Hnlower ->
    (down_env_until γCtx mLower Hnlower) γS<= (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) ->
    exists W, EvalVal γ ρ V W /\ LR A W mLower γCtx.

Definition SemCWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) M (B : CompTy n) :=
  forall ρ γCtx mLower (Hnlower : mLower <= n), ρ_ok γCtx ρ Γ mLower γCtx ->
    γCtx = pad_with Strict (down_env_until γCtx mLower Hnlower) n Hnlower ->
    (down_env_until γCtx mLower Hnlower) γS<= (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) ->
    exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR B T mLower γCtx.

Section SemTyping.

Context {n : nat} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n).

End SemTyping.
=== TYPING ===
Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax.

Require Import Psatz.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Definition context n : Type := fin n -> ValTy n.

Definition ctx_insert {n} (A : ValTy n) (Γ : context n) : context (S n) :=
    (Lazy A↑ A) .: (fun fn => Lazy A↑ (Γ fn)).

Inductive VWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Var i A :
    A = Γ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->

    VWt γ Γ (vVar i) A

  | T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)

  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)

  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)

with CWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Ret V A :
    VWt γ Γ V A ->

    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)

  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B

  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B

  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B

  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_succ_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B

  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B2 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cCase V M1 M2) B

  | T_Abs q M A B B' :
    CWt (q .: γ) (ctx_insert A Γ) M B' ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cAbs M) (CAbs q A B)

  | T_App M q V γ1 γ2 A B:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B

  | T_CSub M γ' B:
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSub M) B
.

Scheme VWt_ind' := Induction for VWt Sort Prop
    with CWt_ind' := Induction for CWt Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme Wt_mutual from VWt_ind', CWt_ind'.

Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax strictness.cbpv.typing.

From Coq Require Export PeanoNat.

From Coq Require Export Bool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Psatz.

Inductive Clos : Kind ->  Type :=
| Absent : Clos ValFlag
| Unit : Clos ValFlag
| Thunk (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter)  (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp mInner) : Clos ValFlag
| Pair (W1 W2 : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Inl (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Inr (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Return (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos CompFlag
| Closure (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter) (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp (S mInner)) : Clos CompFlag.

Definition ClosValue := Clos ValFlag.

Definition ClosComp := Clos CompFlag.

Definition env n := fin n -> ClosValue.

Definition min_le : forall m n, min m n <= m := ltac:(lia).

Fixpoint down_clos {k} scope (C : Clos k) : Clos k :=
  match C with
  | Absent => Absent
  | Unit => Unit
  | Thunk n m γ' ρ M => Thunk (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
  | Pair W1 W2 => Pair (down_clos scope W1) (down_clos scope W2)
  | Inl W => Inl (down_clos scope W)
  | Inr W => Inr (down_clos scope W)
  | Return W => Return (down_clos scope W)
  | Closure n m γ' ρ M => Closure (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
  end.

Definition down_value := @down_clos ValFlag.

Definition down_comp := @down_clos CompFlag.

Notation "scope 'W↓' W" := (down_value scope W) (at level 85).

Notation "scope 'T↓' T" := (down_comp scope T) (at level 85).

    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->
    W <> Absent ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vVar i) W

  | E_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    EvalVal γ ρ vUnit Unit

  | E_Thunk M γ' :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vThunk M) (Thunk n n γ' ρ M)

  | E_VPair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 W1 W2 :
    EvalVal γ1 ρ V1 W1 ->
    EvalVal γ2 ρ V2 W2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vPair V1 V2) (Pair W1 W2)

  | E_Inl V W :
    EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vInl V) (Inl W)

  | E_Inr V W :
    EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vInr V) (Inr W)

| E_Abs M :

  EvalComp γ ρ (cAbs M) (Closure n n γ ρ M)

| E_AppAbs n' m q γ1 γ2 γ' γUp H M M' V T T' W ρ':
  EvalComp γ1 ρ M (Closure n' m γ' ρ' M') ->
  EvalVal γ2 ρ V W ->
  γ' = down_env_until γUp n' H ->
  EvalComp (q .: γUp) ((n' W↓ W) .: ρ') M' T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n' T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cApp M V) T

  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Pair W1 W2) ->
  EvalComp (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (W1 .: (W2 .: ρ)) N T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSplit V N) T

| E_Ret V W :
  EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cRet V) (Return W)

| E_LetRet γ1 γ2 q M N W T T' :
  EvalComp γ1 ρ M (Return W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) N T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cLet M N) T

| E_Force mInner mOuter (γ2'' : attrs n) γ1 (γ2 : attrs mOuter) γ2' V M T T' ρ' Hn HInner :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Thunk mOuter mInner γ2 ρ' M) ->
  EvalComp γ2' ρ' M T' ->
  down_env_until γ2' mOuter HInner = γ2 ->
  down_env_until γ2'' mOuter Hn = γ2 ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2'' ->
  T = (mOuter T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cForce V) T

| E_Seq γ1 γ2 V N T :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V Unit ->
  EvalComp γ2 ρ N T ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSeq V N) T

| E_Casel γ1 γ2 q V M1 M2 W T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Inl W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) M1 T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cCase V M1 M2) T

| E_Caser γ1 γ2 q V M1 M2 W T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Inr W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) M2 T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cCase V M1 M2) T

| E_CSub M γ' B:
  EvalComp γ' ρ M B ->
  γ γ<= γ' ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSub M) B
.

Inductive eq_up_to_attrs : forall (k : Kind), Clos k -> Clos k -> Prop :=
  | Eq_Absent : eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag Absent Absent
  | Eq_Unit : eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag Unit Unit

    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Inl W) (Inl W')

  | Eq_Inr W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Inr W) (Inr W')

  | Eq_Return W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->

  | Eq_Closure n m γ γ' ρ ρ' M :
    (forall i, eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (ρ i) (ρ' i)) ->
    eq_up_to_attrs CompFlag (Closure n m γ ρ M) (Closure n m γ' ρ' M)

Arguments eq_up_to_attrs {k}.

Definition eq_env_up_to_attrs {n} (ρ1 ρ2 : env n) :=
  forall i, eq_up_to_attrs (ρ1 i) (ρ2 i).

Definition EvalValFail {n} (ρ : env n) V :=
  forall γ W ρ', eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' -> ~ EvalVal γ ρ' V W.

Require Export strictness.common.attributes.

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.fintype.

Require Import Psatz.

From Coq Require Export PeanoNat.

From Coq Require Export Bool.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive Kind := ValFlag : Kind | CompFlag : Kind.

Inductive Ty (n : nat) : Kind -> Type :=
  | VUnit : Ty n ValFlag
  | VThunk (γ : attrs n) (B : Ty n CompFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | VProd (A1 : Ty n ValFlag) (A2 : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | VSum (A1 : Ty n ValFlag ) (A2 : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | CAbs (q : attr) (A : Ty n ValFlag) (B : Ty n CompFlag) : Ty n CompFlag
  | CF (A : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n CompFlag
.

Definition ValTy n := Ty n ValFlag.

Definition CompTy n := Ty n CompFlag.

Arguments VUnit {n}.

Arguments VThunk {n}.

Arguments VProd {n}.

Arguments VSum {n}.

Arguments CF {n}.

Arguments CAbs {n}.

Fixpoint ren_ty {n m k} (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (T : Ty n k) : Ty m k :=
  match T with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (ren_ty ξ A1) (ren_ty ξ A2)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (ren_ty ξ A1) (ren_ty ξ A2)
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (ren_env γ ξ) (ren_ty ξ B)
  | CF A => CF (ren_ty ξ A)
  | CAbs q A B => CAbs q (ren_ty ξ A) (ren_ty ξ B)
  end
.

Definition down_ty {n k} (T : Ty (S n) k) : Ty n k := ren_ty shift T.

Definition down_valTy {n} := @down_ty n ValFlag.

Definition down_compTy {n} := @down_ty n CompFlag.

Notation "'A↓' A" := (down_valTy A) (at level 85).

Notation "'B↓' B" := (down_compTy B) (at level 85).

Fixpoint map_Ty {n m k} (ξ : attrs n -> attrs m) (T : Ty n k) : Ty m k :=
  match T with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (ξ γ) (map_Ty ξ B)
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (map_Ty ξ A1) (map_Ty ξ A2)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (map_Ty ξ A1) (map_Ty ξ A2)
  | CF A => CF (map_Ty ξ A)
  | CAbs q' A B => CAbs q' (map_Ty ξ A) (map_Ty ξ B)
  end
.

Definition up_Ty {n k} q (T : Ty n k) : Ty (S n) k := map_Ty (fun γ => q .: γ) T.

Definition up_valTy {n} := @up_Ty n ValFlag.

Definition up_compTy {n} := @up_Ty n CompFlag.

Infix "A↑" := (up_valTy) (at level 85).

Infix "B↑" := (up_compTy) (at level 85).

Fixpoint down_ty_until {n k} (A : Ty n k) m (H : m <= n) : Ty m k :=
  match A with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (down_ty_until A1 m H) (down_ty_until A2 m H)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (down_ty_until A1 m H) (down_ty_until A2 m H)
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (down_env_until γ m H) (down_ty_until B m H)
  | CF A => CF (down_ty_until A m H)
  | CAbs q A B =>
    CAbs q (down_ty_until A m H) (down_ty_until B m H)
  end
.

Definition down_valTy_until {n} := @down_ty_until n ValFlag.

Definition down_compTy_until {n} := @down_ty_until n CompFlag.

Inductive Val (n : nat) : Type :=
  | vVar (x : fin n) : Val n


  | vUnit : Val n


  | vThunk (M : Comp n) : Val n


  | vPair (V1 :Val n) (V2: Val n) : Val n


  | vInl (V : Val n) : Val n
  | vInr (V : Val n) : Val n

 with Comp (n : nat) : Type :=

  | cRet (V : Val n) : Comp n

  | cLet (M : Comp n) (M' : Comp (S n)) : Comp n


  | cForce (V : Val n) : Comp n


  | cSeq (V : Val n) (M : Comp n) : Comp n


  | cAbs (M : Comp (S n)) : Comp n

  | cApp (M : Comp n) (V : Val n) : Comp n


  | cSplit (V : Val n) (M : Comp (S (S (n)))) : Comp n


  | cCase (V : Val n) (M1 : Comp (S n)) (M2 : Comp (S n)) : Comp n


  | cSub (V : Comp n) : Comp n
.

Arguments vVar {n}.

Arguments vUnit {n}.

Arguments vThunk {n}.

Arguments vPair {n}.

Arguments vInl {n}.

Arguments vInr {n}.

Arguments cRet {n}.

Arguments cLet {n}.

Arguments cForce {n}.

Arguments cSeq {n}.

Arguments cAbs {n}.

Arguments cApp {n}.

Arguments cSplit {n}.

Arguments cCase {n}.

Arguments cSub {n}.

Scheme Val_ind' := Induction for Val Sort Prop
    with Comp_ind' := Induction for Comp Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme ValComp_mutual from Val_ind', Comp_ind'.

Definition upRen_Val_Val { m n : nat } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) : fin (S m) -> fin (S n) :=
  up_ren ξ.

Fixpoint ren_Val { m n } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (s : Val m) : Val n :=
    match s return Val n with
    | vVar s => vVar (ξ s)
    | vUnit => vUnit
    | vThunk s0 => vThunk (ren_Comp ξ s0)
    | vPair s0 s1 => vPair (ren_Val ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | vInl s0 => vInl (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | vInr s0 => vInr (ren_Val ξ s0)
    end
 with ren_Comp { m n } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (s : Comp m) : Comp n :=
    match s return Comp n with
    | cAbs s1 => cAbs (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s1)
    | cApp s0 s1 => cApp (ren_Comp ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cForce s0 => cForce (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | cSplit s1 s2 => cSplit (ren_Val ξ s1)
      (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val (upRen_Val_Val ξ)) s2)
    | cRet s1 => cRet (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cLet s1 s2 => cLet (ren_Comp ξ s1) (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)
    | cSeq s0 s1 => cSeq (ren_Val ξ s0) (ren_Comp ξ s1)
    | cCase s1 s2 s3 => cCase (ren_Val ξ s1)
        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)
        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s3)
    | cSub s1 => cSub (ren_Comp ξ s1)
    end.

  | vInl (V : Val n) : Val n
  | vInr (V : Val n) : Val n

Arguments vInl {n}.

Arguments vInr {n}.

Arguments cLet {n}.

Arguments cForce {n}.

Arguments cSeq {n}.

Arguments cAbs {n}.

Arguments cApp {n}.

Arguments cSplit {n}.

    | vInl s0 => vInl (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | vInr s0 => vInr (ren_Val ξ s0)

    | cApp s0 s1 => cApp (ren_Comp ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cForce s0 => cForce (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | cSplit s1 s2 => cSplit (ren_Val ξ s1)
      (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val (upRen_Val_Val ξ)) s2)
    | cRet s1 => cRet (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cLet s1 s2 => cLet (ren_Comp ξ s1) (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)

        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s2)
        (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s3)
    | cSub s1 => cSub (ren_Comp ξ s1)

  | Some f0 =>

       | 0 => fun f2 : fin 0 => False_rec nat f2
       | S n0 =>
           (fun (n1 : nat) (f2 : fin (S n1)) => S (fin_to_nat n1 f2)) n0

  end.

Definition fin_eqb : forall {n : nat}, fin n -> fin n -> bool :=
fun n : nat =>
nat_rec (fun n0 : nat => fin n0 -> fin n0 -> bool)
  (fun _ H : fin 0 => False_rec bool H)
  (fun (n0 : nat) (IHn : fin n0 -> fin n0 -> bool) (i1 i2 : fin (S n0)) =>
   let f := i1 in
   let H1 : i1 = f := eq_refl in
   match f as o return (i1 = o -> bool) with
   | Some f0 =>
       (fun
          (i1' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                    match n1 with
                    | 0 => False
                    | S m => option (fin m)
                    end)
                   n0)
          (_ : i1 = Some i1') =>
        let f1 := i2 in
        let H2 : i2 = f1 := eq_refl in
        match f1 as o return (i2 = o -> bool) with
        | Some f2 =>
            (fun
               (i2' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                         match n1 with
                         | 0 => False
                         | S m => option (fin m)
                         end)
                        n0)
               (_ : i2 = Some i2') =>
             let b := IHn i1' i2' in
             let IHe : IHn i1' i2' = b := eq_refl in
             (if b as b0 return (IHn i1' i2' = b0 -> bool)
              then fun _ : IHn i1' i2' = true => true
              else fun _ : IHn i1' i2' = false => false) IHe) f2
        | None => fun _ : i2 = None => false
        end H2) f0
   | None =>
       fun _ : i1 = None =>
       let f0 := i2 in
       let H2 : i2 = f0 := eq_refl in
       match f0 as o return (i2 = o -> bool) with
       | Some f1 =>
           (fun
              (i2' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                        match n1 with
                        | 0 => False
                        | S m => option (fin m)
                        end)
                       n0)
              (_ : i2 = Some i2') =>
            false) f1
       | None => fun _ : i2 = None => true
       end H2
   end H1)
  n.
Arguments fin_eqb {n} _ _.

Definition up_ren' {n} : ren (S n) (S (S n)) := (var_zero .: shift >> shift).

Definition up2_ren' {n} : ren (S (S n)) (S (S (S n))) := (var_zero .: (shift (var_zero) .: shift >> shift >> shift)).

Definition ren_inj {n m} (renamer : ren n m) :=
    (forall i1 i2, renamer i1 = renamer i2 -> i1 = i2).

Definition ren_match {n m X} (renamer : ren n m)
    (fn : fin n -> X) (fm : fin m -> X) :=
    forall i, fn i = fm (renamer i).

Definition default_or_preimage {n m X} (id : X) (fm : fin m -> X) (renamer : ren n m) :=
    (forall j, fm j = id \/ exists i, j = renamer i).

Inductive ren_preimage_cases {n m} (renamer : ren n m) (j : fin m) : Type :=
    | preimage (i : fin n) (H : j = renamer i) : ren_preimage_cases renamer j
    | no_preimage (H : forall (i : fin n), renamer i <> j) : ren_preimage_cases renamer j
    .

Definition env_map {n}{A B} (f : A -> B) (ρ : fin n -> A) : fin n -> B :=
  fun x => f (ρ (x)).

```
Theorem lazy_soundness : forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) (ρ : env n),
  ρ_ok γ ρ Γ n γ ->
  forall i, γ i = Lazy ->
  (forall V A, VWt γ Γ V A ->
    exists W, EvalVal γ (ρ <- Absent @ i) V W) /\
  (forall M B, CWt γ Γ M B ->
    exists T, EvalComp γ (ρ <- Absent @ i) M T).
```

Hmm. This is a statement that any well-typed value/computation evaluates in the environment where variable i is Absent. It's phrased directly on syntactic typing (`VWt`, `CWt`), not semantic typing. So we can prove this by induction over typing derivations? Let's think.

The claim: if ρ_ok γ ρ Γ n γ (i.e., for all j with γ j ≠ Lazy, LR (Γ j) (ρ j) n γ), and γ i = Lazy, then for all well-typed V:A, V evaluates under ρ' = ρ with i := Absent; similarly for computations.

Actually, is this true? A variable j can be looked up in EvalVal only if γ j = Strict (T_Var requires γ = lazyvector <- Strict @ i for the variable's index). If γ i = Lazy, then for any variable j with γ j = Strict, j ≠ i, so ρ' j = ρ j, and ρ_ok gives LR (Γ j) (ρ j) n γ, which... hmm, LR doesn't imply non-Absent directly? CF requires Return. CAbs requires Closure. So none is Absent. So LR implies non-Absent. Require Export strictness.autosubst2.axioms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Set :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=
  fun x => x.

Definition var_zero {n : nat} : fin (S n) := None.

Definition null {T} (i : fin 0) : T := match i with end.

Definition shift {n : nat} : ren n (S n) :=
  Some.

Definition comp := @funcomp.

Definition scons {X : Type} {n : nat} (x : X) (f : fin n -> X) (m : fin (S n)) : X :=
  match m with
  | None => x
  | Some i => f i
  end.

Class Ren1 (X1  : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren4 (X1 X2 X3 X4 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5 -> Y -> Z.

Declare Scope fscope.

Declare Scope subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ⟩" := (ren1  xi1 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩" := (ren3 xi1 xi2 xi3 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩" := (ren4  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩" := (ren5  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 xi5 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (ren1 xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : fscope.

Class Subst1 (X1 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 ->  Y  -> Z.

Class Subst4 (X1 X2 X3 X4: Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5  -> Y  -> Z.

Notation "s [ sigma ]" := (subst1 sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst2 sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Class Var X Y :=
  ids : X -> Y.

Arguments funcomp {X Y Z} (g) (f).

Notation "f >> g" := (funcomp g f) (at level 50).

Open Scope subst_scope.

Notation "x .: f" := (@scons _ _ x f) (at level 55) : subst_scope.

Definition up_ren m n (xi : ren m n) : ren (S m) (S n) :=
  var_zero .: xi >> shift.

Fixpoint shift_p (p : nat) {n} : ren n (p + n) :=
  fun n => match p with
        | 0 => n
        | S p => Some (shift_p p n)
        end.

Definition scons_p : forall {X : Type} (m : nat) {n : nat},
       (fin m -> X) -> (fin n -> X) -> fin (m + n) -> X :=
fix scons_p (X : Type) (m : nat) {struct m} :
    forall n : nat, (fin m -> X) -> (fin n -> X) -> fin (m + n) -> X :=
  match
    m as n
    return
      (forall n0 : nat, (fin n -> X) -> (fin n0 -> X) -> fin (n + n0) -> X)
  with
  | 0 => fun (n : nat) (_ : fin 0 -> X) (g : fin n -> X) => g
  | S n =>
      (fun (m0 n0 : nat) (f : fin (S m0) -> X) (g : fin n0 -> X) =>
       f var_zero .: scons_p X m0 n0 (fun z : fin m0 => f (Some z)) g
       :
       fin (S m0 + n0) -> X) n
  end.
Arguments scons_p {X} m {n}
  (f g) _.

Definition zero_p : forall (m : nat) {n : nat}, fin m -> fin (m + n) :=
fun m n : nat =>
nat_rec (fun m0 : nat => fin m0 -> fin (m0 + n))
  (fun H : fin 0 => match H return (fin (0 + n)) with
                    end)
  (fun (m0 : nat) (IHm : fin m0 -> fin (m0 + n)) (H : fin (S m0)) =>
   match H with
   | Some f => (fun x : fin m0 => shift_p 1 (IHm x)) f
   | None => var_zero
   end)
  m.
Arguments zero_p m {n} _.

Definition upRen_p p { m : nat } { n : nat } (xi : (fin) (m) -> (fin) (n)) : fin (p + m) -> fin (p + n)  :=
   scons_p p (zero_p p) (xi >> shift_p _).

Arguments upRen_p p {m n} xi.

Module CommaNotation.

Notation "s , sigma" := (scons s sigma) (at level 60, format "s ,  sigma", right associativity) : subst_scope.

End CommaNotation.

Notation "s '..'" := (scons s ids) (at level 1, format "s ..") : subst_scope.

Notation "'list_map'" := map.

  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Fixpoint fin (n : nat) : Set :=
  match n with
  | 0 => False
  | S m => option (fin m)
  end.

Definition ren (m n : nat) : Type := fin m -> fin n.

Definition id {X} (x : X) := x.

Definition idren {k: nat} : ren k k :=

  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : fscope.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst2 sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "x .: f" := (@scons _ _ x f) (at level 55) : subst_scope.

Definition up_ren m n (xi : ren m n) : ren (S m) (S n) :=
  var_zero .: xi >> shift.

  fun n => match p with

        end.

Definition scons_p : forall {X : Type} (m : nat) {n : nat},
       (fin m -> X) -> (fin n -> X) -> fin (m + n) -> X :=
fix scons_p (X : Type) (m : nat) {struct m} :
    forall n : nat, (fin m -> X) -> (fin n -> X) -> fin (m + n) -> X :=
  match
    m as n
    return
      (forall n0 : nat, (fin n -> X) -> (fin n0 -> X) -> fin (n + n0) -> X)
  with
  | 0 => fun (n : nat) (_ : fin 0 -> X) (g : fin n -> X) => g
  | S n =>

       f var_zero .: scons_p X m0 n0 (fun z : fin m0 => f (Some z)) g
       :
       fin (S m0 + n0) -> X) n
  end.
Arguments scons_p {X} m {n}
  (f g) _.

Definition zero_p : forall (m : nat) {n : nat}, fin m -> fin (m + n) :=
fun m n : nat =>
nat_rec (fun m0 : nat => fin m0 -> fin (m0 + n))
  (fun H : fin 0 => match H return (fin (0 + n)) with
                    end)
  (fun (m0 : nat) (IHm : fin m0 -> fin (m0 + n)) (H : fin (S m0)) =>
   match H with
   | Some f => (fun x : fin m0 => shift_p 1 (IHm x)) f
   | None => var_zero

  m.

Lemma castf_refl : forall {a} (x : fin a), castf eq_refl x = x.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma castf_trans : forall {a b c} (e1 : a = b) (e2 : b = c) (x : fin a),
  castf e2 (castf e1 x) = castf (eq_trans e1 e2) x.
Proof. intros. destruct e1, e2. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma castf_sym : forall {a b} (e : a = b) (x : fin b), castf (eq_sym e) (castf e x) = x.
Proof. intros. destruct e. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma shift_p_castf : forall {a b} p (e : a = b) (x : fin a),
  shift_p p (castf e x) = castf (f_equal (fun t => p + t) e) (shift_p p x).

Lemma shift_p_ext : forall {p1 p2 q} (E : p1 = p2) (j : fin q),

Lemma down_clos_small : forall {k} (C : Clos k) m n, m <= n ->
  down_clos m (down_clos n C) = down_clos m C.
Proof.
  intros k C m n Hmn.
  rewrite down_clos_comp.
  rewrite (Nat.min_r n m Hmn).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma down_clos_same : forall {k} (C : Clos k) n, down_clos n (down_clos n C) = down_clos n C.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite down_clos_comp. rewrite (Nat.min_r n n (Nat.le_refl n)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma down_clos_scope_eq : forall {k} (C : Clos k) j1 j2, j1 = j2 -> down_clos j1 C = down_clos j2 C.
Proof. intros. subst. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma LR_ws : forall {n k} (T : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) (gCtx : attrs n),
  LR T C n gCtx -> down_clos n C = C.

  intros n k T. induction T as [|g0 B IHB|A1 IH1 A2 IH2|A1 IH1 A2 IH2|q A0 IH0 B IHB|A IHA];

    subst C.
    apply (@dep_constr_eq nat (Clos ValFlag) attrs (fun t a => Thunk t mi a rho M)
             mo (Nat.min mo n) (eq_sym (Nat.min_l mo n Hn)) gsc
             (down_env_until gsc (Nat.min mo n) (min_le mo n))).
    apply functional_extensionality. intros j.
    erewrite eq_rect_r_fun_attrs.
    rewrite down_env_until_apply'.
    rewrite (@dmap_cast (Nat.min mo n) mo mo (eq_sym (Nat.min_l mo n Hn))
               (min_le mo n) (Nat.le_refl mo) j).
    rewrite dmap_id.
    symmetry. apply down_env_until_full.
  - (* VProd *)
    destruct Hlr as (W1 & W2 & HC & H1 & H2). subst C.
    cbn. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - (* VSum *)

Definition LR_up_prop {n k} (T : Ty n k) : Prop :=
  forall (C : Clos k) (mLower : nat) (gCtx : attrs n) (q : attr),
    LR T C mLower gCtx -> LR (up_Ty q T) C mLower (Strict .: gCtx).

Definition LR_down_prop {n k} (T : Ty n k) : Prop :=
  forall (K : nat) (HK : K <= n) (mLower : nat) (Hml : mLower <= K)
         (C : Clos k) (gCtx : attrs n) (gK : attrs K),
    gK = down_env_until gCtx K HK ->
    LR T C mLower gCtx -> LR (down_ty_until T K HK) (down_clos K C) mLower gK.

Definition LR_lift_prop {n k} (T : Ty n k) : Prop :=
  forall (K : nat) (HK : K <= n) (mLower : nat)
         (C : Clos k) (gCtx : attrs n) (gK : attrs K),
    gK = down_env_until gCtx K HK ->
    LR (down_ty_until T K HK) C mLower gK -> LR T C mLower gCtx.

Definition LR_downup_prop {n k} (T : Ty n k) : Prop :=
  forall (C : Clos k) (mLower : nat) (Hml : mLower <= n) (gCtx : attrs n) (q : attr),
    LR (up_Ty q T) C mLower (Strict .: gCtx) -> LR T (down_clos n C) mLower gCtx.

Definition LR_props {n k} (T : Ty n k) : Prop :=
  LR_up_prop T /\ LR_down_prop T /\ LR_lift_prop T /\ LR_downup_prop T.

Lemma LR_all : forall {n k} (T : Ty n k), LR_props T.
Proof.
  intros n k T.
  induction T as [|g0 B IHB|A1 IH1 A2 IH2|A1 IH1 A2 IH2|q0 A0 IH0 B IHB|A IHA].
  - (* VUnit *)
    split; [|split;[|split]].
    + intros C mLower gCtx q Hlr. cbn in Hlr. subst C. cbn. reflexivity.
    + intros K HK mLower Hml C gCtx gK Hctx Hlr. cbn in Hlr. subst C. cbn. reflexivity.
    + intros K HK mLower C gCtx gK Hctx Hlr. cbn in Hlr. subst C. cbn. reflexivity.
    + intros C mLower Hml gCtx q Hlr. cbn in Hlr. subst C. cbn. reflexivity.
  - (* VThunk *)
    destruct IHB as (upB & dnB & lfB & duB).
    split; [|split;[|split]].
    + (* up *)
      intros C mLower gCtx q Hlr. cbn in Hlr.
      destruct Hlr as (mo & mi & gsc & gInner & rho & M & HInner & Hn & HLow & Hd1 & Hd2 & HC & Hcl).
      cbn.
      assert (HleSn : mo <= S n) by lia.
      assert (HmlN : mLower <= n) by lia.
      eexists mo, mi, gsc, gInner, rho, M.
      exists HInner, HleSn, HLow.
      split; [ rewrite (@down_env_until_cons n mo q g0 HleSn Hn); exact Hd1 |].
      split; [ exact Hd2 |].
      split; [ exact HC |].
      intros Hnl Hstr.
      assert (Hstr0 : down_env_until gCtx mLower HmlN γS<= down_env_until g0 mLower HmlN).
      { intro j.
        rewrite <- (@down_env_until_cons n mLower Strict gCtx Hnl HmlN).
        rewrite <- (@down_env_until_cons n mLower q g0 Hnl HmlN).
        apply Hstr. }
      destruct (Hcl HmlN Hstr0) as (T & Hev & HlrB).
      exists T. split; [ exact Hev | apply upB; exact HlrB ].
    + (* down *)
      intros K HK mLower Hml C gCtx gK Hctx Hlr. cbn in Hlr.
      destruct Hlr as (mo & mi & gsc & gInner & rho & M & HInner & Hn & HLow & Hd1 & Hd2 & HC & Hcl).
      subst C. cbn.
      assert (HleKm : min mo K <= mi) by lia.
      assert (HleKk : min mo K <= K) by lia.
      assert (Hml' : mLower <= min mo K) by lia.
      assert (HmN : mLower <= n) by lia.
      eexists (min mo K), mi, (down_env_until gsc (min mo K) _), gInner, rho, M.
      exists HleKm, HleKk, Hml'.
      split.
      { rewrite <- Hd1.
        erewrite down_env_until_comp.
        erewrite down_env_until_comp.
        erewrite down_env_until_H_irrel. reflexivity. }
      split.

        erewrite down_env_until_comp.
        erewrite down_env_until_comp.
        erewrite down_env_until_H_irrel. reflexivity. }

      assert (Hd := dnB K HK mLower Hml (mo T↓ T) gCtx gK Hctx HlrB).

    + (* lift *)
      intros K HK mLower C gCtx gK Hctx Hlr. cbn in Hlr.
      destruct Hlr as (mo & mi & gsc & gInner & rho & M & HInner & Hn & HLow & Hd1 & Hd2 & HC & Hcl).

      assert (HmlK : mLower <= K) by lia.

      exists HInner, HnN, HLow.
      split.

        erewrite down_env_until_comp.
        erewrite down_env_until_H_irrel. reflexivity. }
      split; [ exact Hd2 |].
      split; [ exact HC |].
      intros Hnl Hstr.
      assert (Hstr0 : down_env_until gK mLower Hnl γS<= down_env_until (down_env_until g0 K HK) mLower Hnl).

        rewrite Hctx.
        rewrite (@down_env_until_comp attr n K mLower HmlK HK gCtx).

        apply Hstr. }
      destruct (Hcl Hnl Hstr0) as (T & Hev & HlrB).

    + (* downup *)
      intros C mLower Hml gCtx q Hlr. cbn in Hlr.
      destruct Hlr as (mo & mi & gsc & gInner & rho & M & HInner & Hn & HLow & Hd1 & Hd2 & HC & Hcl).
      subst C. cbn.
      assert (Hle : min mo n <= mi) by lia.
      assert (Hlen : min mo n <= n) by lia.
      assert (Hml' : mLower <= min mo n) by lia.
      assert (HleS : mLower <= S n) by lia.
      eexists (min mo n), mi, (down_env_until gsc (min mo n) _), gInner, rho, M.
      exists Hle, Hlen, Hml'.
      split.

      * apply (lf2 K HK mLower W2 gCtx gK Hctx H2).

From strictness.cbpv Require Import lazy_semtyping.
Lemma if_bool_id : forall b : bool,
  (if b as b0 return (b = b0 -> bool) then (fun _ => true) else (fun _ => false)) eq_refl = b.
Proof. intros b. destruct b; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma fin_eqb_Some : forall {n} (i j : fin n), fin_eqb (Some i : fin (S n)) (Some j : fin (S n)) = fin_eqb i j.
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  change ((if fin_eqb i j as b0 return (fin_eqb i j = b0 -> bool)
           then (fun _ => true) else (fun _ => false)) eq_refl = fin_eqb i j).
  apply if_bool_id.
Qed.
Lemma fin_eqb_None : forall {n}, fin_eqb (None : fin (S n)) (None : fin (S n)) = true.
Proof. intros. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma fin_eqb_Some_None : forall {n} (i : fin n), fin_eqb (Some i : fin (S n)) (None : fin (S n)) = false.
Proof. intros. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma fin_eqb_None_Some : forall {n} (j : fin n), fin_eqb (None : fin (S n)) (Some j : fin (S n)) = false.
Proof. intros. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma fin_eqb_refl : forall {n} (i : fin n), fin_eqb i i = true.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros i.
  - destruct i.
  - destruct i as [i'|].
    + rewrite fin_eqb_Some. apply IH.
    + apply fin_eqb_None.
Qed.
Lemma fin_eqb_true_iff : forall {n} (i j : fin n), fin_eqb i j = true <-> i = j.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros i j.
  - destruct i.
  - destruct i as [i'|], j as [j'|].
    + rewrite fin_eqb_Some. split; intro H.
      * f_equal. apply (proj1 (IH i' j')). exact H.
      * injection H as H. apply (proj2 (IH i' j')). exact H.
    + rewrite fin_eqb_Some_None. split; intro H; discriminate H.
    + rewrite fin_eqb_None_Some. split; intro H; discriminate H.
    + rewrite fin_eqb_None. split; intro H; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma fin_eqb_neq : forall {n} (i j : fin n), i <> j -> fin_eqb i j = false.
Proof.
  intros n i j H. destruct (fin_eqb i j) eqn:E.
  - exfalso. apply H. apply (proj1 (fin_eqb_true_iff i j)). exact E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma env_set_same : forall {n A} (f : fin n -> A) i a, (f <- a @ i) i = a.
Proof. intros. unfold env_set. rewrite fin_eqb_refl. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma env_set_neq : forall {n A} (f : fin n -> A) i j a, i <> j -> (f <- a @ i) j = f j.
Proof. intros. unfold env_set. rewrite (fin_eqb_neq H). reflexivity. Qed.
EOF

Section SemTyping.
Context {n : nat} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n).

End SemTyping.

Definition SemV {n : nat} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) (V : Val n) (A : ValTy n) : Prop :=
  forall (ρ : env n) (gCtx : attrs n) (mLower : nat) (Hnl : mLower <= n) (v : attrs mLower),
    ρ_ok gCtx ρ Γ mLower gCtx ->
    PadTo gCtx v ->
    down_env_until gCtx mLower Hnl = v ->
    (down_env_until gCtx mLower Hnl) γS<= (down_env_until γ mLower Hnl) ->
    exists W, EvalVal γ ρ V W /\ LR A W mLower gCtx.

Definition SemC {n : nat} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) (M : Comp n) (B : CompTy n) : Prop :=
  forall (ρ : env n) (gCtx : attrs n) (mLower : nat) (Hnl : mLower <= n) (v : attrs mLower),
    ρ_ok gCtx ρ Γ mLower gCtx ->
    PadTo gCtx v ->
    down_env_until gCtx mLower Hnl = v ->
    (down_env_until gCtx mLower Hnl) γS<= (down_env_until γ mLower Hnl) ->
    exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR B T mLower gCtx.

Lemma SemWt_core : forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n),
  (forall (V : Val n) (A : ValTy n), VWt γ Γ V A -> SemV γ Γ V A) /\
  (forall (M : Comp n) (B : CompTy n), CWt γ Γ M B -> SemC γ Γ M B).
Proof.
  intros n γ Γ.
  apply Wt_mutual.
EOF
